_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. The core is five machines and each takes its own kind of file, so each has its own slot. Choosing Game Gear offers Game Gear cartridges only, and the Sega CD is the machine that takes discs. Only the slot of the chosen machine is shown (the exposedWhen conditions do this). The machine comes from the project and never from a file name.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge ROM. A cartridge for another console is refused, because the project decides the machine and the file does not.

slots.title: Sega CD discs
slots.help: Sega CD / Mega CD disc images. Each is a .cue file, whose track files join the project automatically, or a raw single-track dump (.iso or .bin). The first disc is in the drive when the machine starts. The order here is the order the Previous Disk and Next Disk inputs go through. The CD BIOS of the matching region is needed and is asked for on the firmware page.
